countedBy: lane landmarks-r19-a-20261127 from the whole-face rectified crop of b_20250120_0926_Track25_Sphere_00005 (2025, Keizersgracht front, 40 px/m) and w03-175.jpg (2022, chamfer, 50.45 px/m); not yet blind-counted. Glazed openings bottom row first; the solid wooden doors do not count. The Leidsestraat front is not counted: no frontal crop of it exists (the brief crop shows the building across the street) and the model mirrors the Keizersgracht scheme onto it.

facades.name: Keizersgracht front
facades.note: Bands from the 2025 crop: the ground storey's centre shopfront and the corner pavilion's shop window (the north-west pavilion's carved door is wood); the mezzanine's three (the door pavilion's window, the centre shopfront's upper glazing as one ribbon, the corner pavilion's window); three storeys of five axes (pavilion, three centre axes, pavilion); over the cornice the door pavilion's attic pair of round-headed lights and the glazed roof storey's ribbon in one band. Not symmetric: door against shop window in the pavilions' ground storey. Cropped to the 15.6 m front (alongM: from the north-west party wall to the chamfer). Columns: the five window axes plus the attic's two round-headed lights, which stand 0.55 m either side of the door pavilion's axis (the 2025 crop), not on it.

facades.name: Chamfer
facades.note: Bands from the 2022 crop: the glazed transom over the corner door (the door leaves are wood), then one window per storey on the axis (second storey between the figures, third behind the bowed balcony, fourth behind the straight balcony) and the attic's pair of small lights under the relief. The mezzanine opening reads as a white panel (a blind behind glass) and is drawn as one; it is not counted. Cropped to the 4.4 m chamfer under the tower (alongM centred on the tower shaft in the probe elevation: the oblique fronts either side are their own walls).
